findings.highlight: It doesn't feel like I got him.
findings.governingReading: 手応えはなかった describes the ease/lack of physical resistance as the next line shows the cut body split like a tomato.
findings.explanation: No resistance felt in the blow becomes feeling he did not hit Zouken.

findings.governingReading: 勢いを殺せず describes failed braking as he tumbles out, subsequently hurting all over.
findings.explanation: Inability to stop his momentum becomes deliberately preserving it.

findings.highlight: The moist ground lets go of my feet.
findings.evidenceJa: 水気に満ちた土から足を離す
findings.governingReading: 土から足を離す assigns the movement to him as he attempts a backward jump.
findings.explanation: Shirou lifting feet off wet earth becomes the earth releasing his feet.

findings.highlight: On my hands and knees, I try to escape the bog on the remaining stumps of my feet.
findings.evidenceJa: 両腕だけでぬかるみから出ようと試みる
findings.governingReading: 這いつくばったまま、両腕だけで ... 出ようと試みる explicitly limits propulsion to the arms after both feet detach.
findings.explanation: Crawling solely with his arms becomes using knee position and foot stumps to escape.
